name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy & Parsley Mashed Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Transfer to a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine beef, bread crumbs, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Mix well and form into 6 patties.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
⅜ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in pan. Add beef patties and cook until browned and almost cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings.
Once patties have been transferred, add more butter and onion to pan. Stirring frequently, cook until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Wash and slice mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Add mushrooms, garlic, and thyme to pan. Stirring occasionally, cook until mushrooms are tender, 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour and broth until smooth. Add to pan and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp all-purpose flour
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Return beef patties and any juices to pan. Cover and simmer until gravy thickens and steaks are cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add butter, broth, ½ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing), salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place mashed potatoes on a plate and top with steaks and gravy. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!
